objective: Add a generic, provenance-bound destination-control path above the existing direct cake orchestrator so an authoritative English, domain, or quarantine label cannot be overridden by prompt text and a missing selected domain cannot fall through to the English core.
decision_rule: Construct-pass only if every focused and complete-suite test passes, the unchanged campaign verifier passes, missing/unknown/quarantined authoritative destinations never invoke the English core, installed domain labels cannot be overridden by prompt text, and existing orchestration behavior remains unchanged. claim_boundary: Generic post-release LayerCake host-control construct only. No external acquisition, package quality, English quality, domain quality, information-minimum, performance, ABI, or release recertification claim is inherited.
